title: IBC Tank Tap Adapter Kit – Connection for Water Tank & Garden
descriptionHtml:
Hard to connect a hose to the IBC tank?

The IBC tank's coarse-threaded outlet doesn't fit ordinary garden hoses – so you end up with the wrong thread, leaks and no easy way to draw water for irrigation or animals.

Connect – draw water right away

The adapter kit turns the IBC tank's outlet into a standard tap and hose connection that fits both European and American thread standards. Connect a hose, tap or irrigation in seconds – tight and leak-free.

Features

  • Fits standard IBC tanks – simple screw-on.
  • EU & US thread standard – fits most hoses.
  • Leak-free connection – seals properly.
  • For irrigation, animals and household.
